features.title: AbortController & AbortSignal
features.description: Controller object that allows you to abort one or more DOM requests made with the Fetch API.

features.title: Accelerometer
features.description: Defines `Accelerometer`, `LinearAccelerationSensor` and `GravitySensor` interfaces for obtaining information about acceleration applied to the X, Y and Z axis of a device that hosts the sensor.

features.title: Ambient Light Sensor
features.description: Defines a concrete sensor interface to monitor the ambient light level or illuminance of the device’s environment.

features.title: Array.prototype.find
features.description: The `find()` method returns the value of the first item in the array based on the result of the provided testing function.

features.title: Array.prototype.findIndex
features.description: The `findIndex()` method returns the index of the first element in the array that satisfies the provided testing function.

features.title: flat & flatMap array methods
features.description: Methods to flatten any sub-arrays found in an array by concatenating their elements.

features.title: Array.prototype.includes
features.description: Determines whether or not an array includes the given value, returning a boolean value (unlike `indexOf`).

features.title: Arrow functions
features.description: Function shorthand using `=>` syntax and lexical `this` binding.

features.title: asm.js
features.description: An extraordinarily optimizable, low-level subset of JavaScript, intended to be a compile target from languages like C++.

features.title: Asynchronous Clipboard API
features.description: A modern, asynchronous Clipboard API based on Promises

features.title: Async functions
features.description: Async functions make it possible to treat functions returning Promise objects as if they were synchronous.

features.title: Base64 encoding and decoding
features.description: Utility functions for encoding and decoding strings to and from base 64: window.atob() and window.btoa().

features.title: Web Audio API
features.description: High-level JavaScript API for processing and synthesizing audio

features.title: Auxclick
features.description: The click event for non-primary buttons of input devices

features.title: CSS background-attachment
features.description: Method of defining how a background image is attached to a scrollable element. Values include `scroll` (default), `fixed` and `local`.

features.title: Background-clip: text
features.description: Clipping a background image to the foreground text.

features.title: CSS3 Background-image options
features.description: New properties to affect background images, including background-clip, background-origin and background-size

features.title: background-position-x & background-position-y
features.description: CSS longhand properties to define x or y positions separately.

features.title: CSS background-repeat round and space
features.description: Allows CSS background images to be repeated without clipping.

features.title: Background Sync API
features.description: Provides one-off and periodic synchronization for Service Workers with an onsync event.

features.title: Battery Status API
features.description: Method to provide information about the battery status of the hosting device.

features.title: Beacon API
features.description: Allows data to be sent asynchronously to a server with `navigator.sendBeacon`, even after a page was closed. Useful for posting analytics data the moment a user was finished using the page.

features.title: Printing Events
features.description: Window fires `beforeprint` and `afterprint` events so the printed document can be annotated.

features.title: BigInt
features.description: Arbitrary-precision integers in JavaScript.

features.title: Blob constructing
features.description: Construct Blobs (binary large objects) either using the BlobBuilder API (deprecated) or the Blob constructor.

features.title: Blob URLs
features.description: Method of creating URL handles to the specified File or Blob object.

features.title: CSS3 Border images
features.description: Method of using images for borders

features.title: CSS3 Border-radius (rounded corners)
features.description: Method of making the border corners round. Covers support for the shorthand `border-radius` as well as the long-hand properties (e.g. `border-top-left-radius`)

features.title: BroadcastChannel
features.description: BroadcastChannel allows scripts from the same origin but other browsing contexts (windows, workers) to send each other messages.

features.title: calc() as CSS unit value
features.description: Method of allowing calculated values for length units, i.e. `width: calc(100% - 3em)`

features.title: ch (character) unit
features.description: Unit representing the width of the character "0" in the current font, of particular use in combination with monospace fonts.

features.title: Channel messaging
features.description: Method for having two-way communication between browsing contexts (using MessageChannel)

features.title: Synchronous Clipboard API
features.description: API to provide copy, cut and paste events as well as provide access to the OS clipboard.

features.title: Basic console logging functions
features.description: Method of outputting data to the browser's console, intended for development purposes.

features.title: console.time and console.timeEnd
features.description: Functions for measuring performance

features.title: const
features.description: Declares a constant with block level scope

features.title: Constraint Validation API
features.description: API for better control over form field validation. Includes support for `checkValidity()`, `setCustomValidity()`, `reportValidity()` and validation states.

features.title: Cookie Store API
features.description: An API for reading and modifying cookies. Compared to the existing `document.cookie` method, the API provides a much more modern interface, which can also be used in service workers.

features.title: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing
features.description: Method of performing XMLHttpRequests across domains

features.title: createImageBitmap
features.description: Create image bitmap with support for resizing and adjusting quality

features.title: Credential Management API
features.description: API that provides a programmatic interface to the browser's credential manager. In short, an origin can request a user's credentials to sign them in, or can ask the browser to save credentials on the user's behalf. Both of these requests are user-mediated.

features.title: View Transitions (cross-document)
features.description: Provides a mechanism for easily creating animated transitions between different DOM states, while also updating the DOM contents in a single step. This API is specific to cross-document transitions.

features.title: Web Cryptography
features.description: JavaScript API for performing basic cryptographic operations in web applications

features.title: CSS all property
features.description: A shorthand property for resetting all CSS properties except for `direction` and `unicode-bidi`.

features.title: CSS Anchor Positioning
features.description: Allows placing elements anywhere on the page relative to an "anchor element", without regard to the layout of other elements besides their containing block

features.title: CSS Animation
features.description: Complex method of animating certain properties of an element

features.title: CSS :any-link selector
features.description: The `:any-link` CSS pseudo-class matches all elements that match `:link` or `:visited`

features.title: CSS Appearance
features.description: The `appearance` property defines how elements (particularly form controls) appear by default. By setting the value to `none` the default appearance can be entirely redefined using other CSS properties.

features.title: CSS Counter Styles
features.description: The @counter-style CSS at-rule allows custom counter styles to be defined. A @counter-style rule defines how to convert a counter value into a string representation.

features.title: CSS Backdrop Filter
features.description: Method of applying filter effects (like blur, grayscale or hue) to content/elements below the target element.

features.title: CSS background-position edge offsets
features.description: Allows CSS background images to be positioned relative to the specified edge using the 3 to 4 value syntax. For example: `background-position: right 5px bottom 5px;` for positioning 5px from the bottom-right corner.

features.title: CSS background-blend-mode
features.description: Allows blending between CSS background images, gradients, and colors.

features.title: CSS box-decoration-break
features.description: Controls whether the box's margins, borders, padding, and other decorations wrap the broken edges of the box fragments (when the box is split by a break (page/column/region/line).

features.title: CSS3 Box-shadow
features.description: Method of displaying an inner or outer shadow effect to elements

features.title: CSS Canvas Drawings
features.description: Method of using HTML5 Canvas as a background image. Not currently part of any specification.

features.title: CSS caret-color
features.description: The `caret-color` property allows the color to be set of the caret (blinking text insertion pointer) in an editable text area.

features.title: CSS Cascade Layers
features.description: The `@layer` at-rule allows authors to explicitly layer their styles in the cascade, before specificity and order of appearance are considered.

features.title: Scoped Styles: the @scope rule
features.description: Allows CSS rules to be scoped to part of the document, with upper and lower limits described by selectors.

features.title: Case-insensitive CSS attribute selectors
features.description: Including an `i` before the `]` in a CSS attribute selector causes the attribute value to be matched in an ASCII-case-insensitive manner. For example, `[b="xyz" i]` would match both `<a b="xyz">` and `<a b="XYZ">`.

features.title: CSS clip-path property (for HTML)
features.description: Method of defining the visible region of an HTML element using SVG or a shape definition.

features.title: CSS print-color-adjust
features.description: The `print-color-adjust` (or `-webkit-print-color-adjust` as prefixed in WebKit/Blink browsers) property is a CSS extension that can be used to force printing of background colors and images.

features.title: CSS color() function
features.description: The CSS `color()` function allows the browser to display colors in any color space, such as the P3 color space which can display colors outside of the default sRGB color space.

features.title: CSS Conical Gradients
features.description: Method of defining a conical or repeating conical color gradient as a CSS image.

features.title: CSS Container Queries (Size)
features.description: Size queries in Container Queries provide a way to query the size of a container, and conditionally apply CSS to the content of that container.

features.title: CSS Container Style Queries
features.description: Style queries in Container Queries provide a way to query the current styling of a container, and conditionally apply additional CSS to the contents of that container.

features.title: CSS Container Query Units
features.description: Container Query Units specify a length relative to the dimensions of a query container. The units include: `cqw`, `cqh`, `cqi`, `cqb`, `cqmin`, and `cqmax`.

features.title: CSS Containment
features.description: The CSS `contain` property lets developers limit the scope of the browser's styles, layout and paint work for faster and more efficient rendering.

features.title: CSS content-visibility
features.description: Provides control over when elements are rendered, so rendering can be skipped for elements not yet in the user's viewport.

features.title: CSS Counters
features.description: Method of controlling number values in generated content, using the `counter-reset` and `counter-increment` properties.

features.title: Crisp edges/pixelated images
features.description: Scales images with an algorithm that preserves edges and contrast, without smoothing colors or introducing blur. This is intended for images such as pixel art. Official values that accomplish this for the `image-rendering` property are `crisp-edges` and `pixelated`.

features.title: CSS Cross-Fade Function
features.description: Image function to create a "crossfade" between images. This allows one image to transition (fade) into another based on a percentage value.

features.title: :default CSS pseudo-class
features.description: The `:default` pseudo-class matches checkboxes and radio buttons which are checked by default, `<option>`s with the `selected` attribute, and the default submit button (if any) of a form.

features.title: Explicit descendant combinator >>
features.description: An explicit, non-whitespace spelling of the descendant combinator. `A >> B` is equivalent to `A B`.

features.title: CSS Device Adaptation
features.description: Method of overriding the size of viewport in web page using the `@viewport` rule, replacing Apple's own popular `<meta>` viewport implementation. Includes the `extend-to-zoom` width value.

features.title: :dir() CSS pseudo-class
features.description: Matches elements based on their directionality. `:dir(ltr)` matches elements which are Left-to-Right. `:dir(rtl)` matches elements which are Right-to-Left.

features.title: CSS display: contents
features.description: `display: contents` causes an element's children to appear as if they were direct children of the element's parent, ignoring the element itself. This can be useful when a wrapper element should be ignored when using CSS grid or similar layout techniques.

features.title: CSS element() function
features.description: This function renders a live image generated from an arbitrary HTML element

features.title: CSS Environment Variables env()
features.description: Usage of environment variables like `safe-area-inset-top`.

features.title: CSS Exclusions Level 1
features.description: Exclusions defines how inline content flows around elements. It extends the content wrapping ability of floats to any block-level element.

features.title: CSS Feature Queries
features.description: CSS Feature Queries allow authors to condition rules based on whether particular property declarations are supported in CSS using the @supports at rule.

features.title: CSS filter() function
features.description: This function filters a CSS input image with a set of filter functions (like blur, grayscale or hue)

features.title: CSS Filter Effects
features.description: Method of applying filter effects using the `filter` property to elements, matching filters available in SVG. Filter functions include blur, brightness, contrast, drop-shadow, grayscale, hue-rotate, invert, opacity, sepia and saturate.

features.title: ::first-letter CSS pseudo-element selector
features.description: CSS pseudo-element that allows styling only the first "letter" of text within an element. Useful for implementing initial caps or drop caps styling.

features.title: CSS first-line pseudo-element
features.description: Allows styling specifically for the first line of text using the `::first-line` pseudo-element. Note that only a limited set of properties can be applied.

features.title: CSS position:fixed
features.description: Method of keeping an element in a fixed location regardless of scroll position

features.title: :focus-visible CSS pseudo-class
features.description: The `:focus-visible` pseudo-class applies while an element matches the `:focus` pseudo-class, and the UA determines via heuristics that the focus should be specially indicated on the element (typically via a “focus ring”).

features.title: :focus-within CSS pseudo-class
features.description: The `:focus-within` pseudo-class matches elements that either themselves match `:focus` or that have descendants which match `:focus`.

features.title: CSS font-palette
features.description: The font-palette CSS property allows selecting a palette from a color font. In combination with the `@font-palette-values` at-rule, custom palettes can be defined.

features.title: CSS font-display
features.description: `@font-face` descriptor `font-display` that allows control over how a downloadable font renders before it is fully loaded.

features.title: CSS font-stretch
features.description: If a font has multiple types of variations based on the width of characters, this property allows the appropriate one to be selected. The property in itself does not cause the browser to stretch to a font. Note that `font-stretch` is an alias of the [`font-width`](/wf-font-width) CSS property.

features.title: CSS Generated content for pseudo-elements
features.description: Method of displaying text or images before or after the given element's contents using the ::before and ::after pseudo-elements. All browsers with support also support the `attr()` notation in the `content` property.

features.title: CSS Gradients
features.description: Method of defining a linear or radial color gradient as a CSS image.

features.title: CSS Grid Layout (level 1)
features.description: Method of using a grid concept to lay out content, providing a mechanism for authors to divide available space for layout into columns and rows using a set of predictable sizing behaviors. Includes support for all `grid-*` properties and the `fr` unit.

features.title: CSS Grid Lanes
features.description: CSS Grid Lanes extends CSS Grid to create layouts with columns *or* rows (not both), allowing mixed aspect ratio content to pack neatly (also known as  "masonry" or "waterfall" layout).

features.title: CSS hanging-punctuation
features.description: Allows some punctuation characters from start (or the end) of text elements to be placed "outside" of the box in order to preserve the reading flow.

features.title: :has() CSS relational pseudo-class
features.description: Select elements containing specific content. For example, `a:has(img)` selects all `` elements that contain an `` child.

features.title: CSS Hyphenation
features.description: Method of controlling when words at the end of lines should be hyphenated using the "hyphens" property.

features.title: CSS if() function
features.description: The `if()` CSS function allows different values to be set for a property depending on the result of a conditional test. The test can be based on a style query, a media query, or a feature query.

features.title: CSS3 image-orientation
features.description: CSS property used generally to fix the intended orientation of an image. This can be done using 90 degree increments or based on the image's EXIF data using the "from-image" value.

features.title: CSS image-set
features.description: Method of letting the browser pick the most appropriate CSS image from a given set.

features.title: :in-range and :out-of-range CSS pseudo-classes
features.description: If a temporal or number `<input>` has `max` and/or `min` attributes, then `:in-range` matches when the value is within the specified range and `:out-of-range` matches when the value is outside the specified range. If there are no range constraints, then neither pseudo-class matches.

features.title: :indeterminate CSS pseudo-class
features.description: The `:indeterminate` pseudo-class matches indeterminate checkboxes, indeterminate `<progress>` bars, and radio buttons with no checked button in their radio button group.

features.title: CSS Initial Letter
features.description: Method of creating an enlarged cap, including a drop or raised cap, in a robust way.

features.title: CSS initial value
features.description: A CSS value that will apply a property's initial value as defined in the CSS specification that defines the property

features.title: LCH and Lab color values
features.description: The `lch()` and `lab()` color functions are based on the CIE LAB color space, representing colors in a way that closely matches human perception and provides access to a wider spectrum of colors than offered by the usual RGB color space.

features.title: letter-spacing CSS property
features.description: Controls spacing between characters of text (i.e. "tracking" in typographical terms). Not to be confused with kerning.

features.title: CSS line-clamp
features.description: CSS property that will contain text to a given amount of lines when used in combination with `display: -webkit-box`. It will end with ellipsis when `text-overflow: ellipsis` is included.

features.title: CSS Logical Properties
features.description: Logical properties and values provide control of layout through logical, rather than physical, direction and dimension mappings. These properties are `writing-mode` relative equivalents of their corresponding physical properties.

features.title: CSS ::marker pseudo-element
features.description: The `::marker` pseudo-element allows list item markers to be styled or have their content value customized.

features.title: CSS Masks
features.description: Method of displaying part of an element, using a selected image as a mask

features.title: :is() CSS pseudo-class
features.description: The `:is()` (formerly `:matches()`, formerly `:any()`) pseudo-class checks whether the element at its position in the outer selector matches any of the selectors in its selector list. It's useful syntactic sugar that allows you to avoid writing out all the combinations manually as separate selectors. The effect is similar to nesting in Sass and most other CSS preprocessors.

features.title: CSS math functions min(), max() and clamp()
features.description: More advanced mathematical expressions in addition to `calc()`

features.title: Media Queries: interaction media features
features.description: Allows a media query to be set based on the presence and accuracy of the user's pointing device, and whether they have the ability to hover over elements on the page. This includes the `pointer`, `any-pointer`, `hover`, and `any-hover` media features.

features.title: Media Queries: Range Syntax
features.description:
Syntax improvements to make media queries using features that have a "range" type (like width or height) less verbose. Can be used with ordinary mathematical comparison operators: `>`, `<`, `>=`, or `<=`.

For example: `@media (100px <= width <= 1900px)` is the equivalent of `@media (min-width: 100px) and (max-width: 1900px)`

features.title: Media Queries: resolution feature
features.description: Allows a media query to be set based on the device pixels used per CSS unit. While the standard uses `min`/`max-resolution` for this, some browsers support the older non-standard `device-pixel-ratio` media query.

features.title: CSS3 Media Queries
features.description: Method of applying styles based on media information. Includes things like page and device dimensions

features.title: Blending of HTML/SVG elements
features.description: Allows blending between arbitrary SVG and HTML elements

features.title: CSS Motion Path
features.description: Allows elements to be animated along SVG paths or shapes via the `offset-path` property. Originally defined as the `motion-path` property.

features.title: CSS namespaces
features.description: Using the `@namespace` at-rule, elements of other namespaces (e.g. SVG) can be targeted using the pipe (`|`) selector.

features.title: CSS Nesting
features.description: CSS nesting provides the ability to nest one style rule inside another, with the selector of the child rule relative to the selector of the parent rule. Similar behavior previously required a CSS pre-processor.

features.title: selector list argument of :not()
features.description: Selectors Level 3 only allowed `:not()` pseudo-class to accept a single simple selector, which the element must not match any of. Thus, `:not(a, .b, [c])` or `:not(a.b[c])` did not work. Selectors Level 4 allows `:not()` to accept a list of selectors. Thus, `:not(a):not(.b):not([c])` can instead be written as `:not(a, .b, [c])` and `:not(a.b[c])` works as intended.

features.title: selector list argument of :nth-child and :nth-last-child CSS pseudo-classes
features.description: The newest versions of `:nth-child()` and `:nth-last-child()` accept an optional `of S` clause which filters the children to only those which match the selector list `S`. For example, `:nth-child(1 of .foo)` selects the first child among the children that have the `foo` class (ignoring any non-`foo` children which precede that child). Similar to `:nth-of-type`, but for arbitrary selectors instead of only type selectors.

features.title: CSS3 Opacity
features.description: Method of setting the transparency level of an element

features.title: :optional CSS pseudo-class
features.description: The `:optional` pseudo-class matches form inputs (`<input>`, `<textarea>`, `<select>`) which are not `:required`.

features.title: CSS overflow property
features.description: Originally a single property for controlling overflowing content in both horizontal & vertical directions, the `overflow` property is now a shorthand for `overflow-x` & `overflow-y`. The latest version of the specification also introduces the `clip` value that blocks programmatic scrolling.

features.title: CSS overflow-anchor (Scroll Anchoring)
features.description:
Changes in DOM elements above the visible region of a scrolling box can result in the page moving while the user is in the middle of consuming the content.
By default, the value of  `overflow-anchor` is `auto`, it can mitigate this jarring user experience by keeping track of the position of an anchor node and adjusting the scroll offset accordingly

features.title: CSS overflow: overlay
features.description: The `overlay` value of the `overflow` CSS property is a non-standard value to make scrollbars appear on top of content rather than take up space. This value is deprecated and related functionality being standardized as [the `scrollbar-gutter` property](mdn-css_properties_scrollbar-gutter).

features.title: CSS overscroll-behavior
features.description: CSS property to control the behavior when the scroll position of a scroll container reaches the edge of the scrollport.

features.title: CSS page-break properties
features.description: Properties to control the way elements are broken across (printed) pages.

features.title: CSS Painting API
features.description: Allows programmatic generation of images used by CSS

features.title: ::placeholder CSS pseudo-element
features.description: The ::placeholder pseudo-element represents placeholder text in an input field: text that represents the input and provides a hint to the user on how to fill out the form. For example, a date-input field might have the placeholder text `YYYY-MM-DD` to clarify that numeric dates are to be entered in year-month-day order.

features.title: :placeholder-shown CSS pseudo-class
features.description: Input elements can sometimes show placeholder text as a hint to the user on what to type in. See, for example, the placeholder attribute in HTML5. The :placeholder-shown pseudo-class matches an input element that is showing such placeholder text.

features.title: CSS :read-only and :read-write selectors
features.description: :read-only and :read-write pseudo-classes to match elements which are considered user-alterable

features.title: Rebeccapurple color
features.description: The new color added in CSS Color Module Level 4

features.title: CSS Reflections
features.description: Method of displaying a reflection of an element

features.title: CSS Regions
features.description: Method of flowing content into multiple elements, allowing magazine-like layouts. While once supported in WebKit-based browsers and Internet Explorer, implementing the feature is no longer being pursued by any browser.

features.title: CSS Relative color syntax
features.description: Relative color syntax in CSS allows a color to be defined relative to another color using the `from` keyword and optionally `calc()` for any of the color values.

features.title: CSS Repeating Gradients
features.description: Method of defining a repeating linear or radial color gradient as a CSS image.

features.title: CSS resize property
features.description: Method of allowing an element to be resized by the user, with options to limit to a given direction.

features.title: CSS revert value
features.description: A CSS keyword value that resets a property's value to the default specified by the browser in its UA stylesheet, as if the webpage had not included any CSS. For example, `display:revert` on a `<div>` would result in `display:block`. This is in contrast to the `initial` value, which is simply defined on a per-property basis, and for `display` would be `inline`.

features.title: #rrggbbaa hex color notation
features.description: The CSS Color Module Level 4 defines new 4 & 8 character hex notation for color to include the opacity level.

features.title: CSS Scroll-behavior
features.description: Method of specifying the scrolling behavior for a scrolling box, when scrolling happens due to navigation or CSSOM scrolling APIs.

features.title: CSS scrollbar styling
features.description: Methods of styling scrollbars' color and width.

features.title: CSS 2.1 selectors
features.description: Basic CSS selectors including: `*` (universal selector), `>` (child selector), `:first-child`, `:link`, `:visited`, `:active`, `:hover`, `:focus`, `:lang()`, `+` (adjacent sibling selector), `[attr]`, `[attr="val"]`, `[attr~="val"]`, `[attr|="bar"]`, `.foo` (class selector), `#foo` (id selector)

features.title: CSS3 selectors
features.description: Advanced element selection using selectors including: `[foo^="bar"]`, `[foo$="bar"]`, `[foo*="bar"]`, `:root`, `:nth-child()`,  `:nth-last-child()`, `:nth-of-type()`, `:nth-last-of-type()`, `:last-child`, `:first-of-type`, `:last-of-type`, `:only-child`, `:only-of-type`, `:empty`, `:target`, `:enabled`, `:disabled`, `:checked`, `:not()`, `~` (general sibling)

features.title: ::selection CSS pseudo-element
features.description: The ::selection CSS pseudo-element applies rules to the portion of a document that has been highlighted (e.g., selected with the mouse or another pointing device) by the user.

features.title: CSS Shapes Level 1
features.description: Allows geometric shapes to be set in CSS to define an area for text to flow around. Includes properties `shape-outside`, `shape-margin` and `shape-image-threshold`

features.title: CSS Scroll Snap
features.description: CSS technique that allows customizable scrolling experiences like pagination of carousels by setting defined snap positions.

features.title: CSS position:sticky
features.description: Keeps elements positioned as "fixed" or "relative" depending on how it appears in the viewport. As a result the element is "stuck" when necessary while scrolling.

features.title: CSS Subgrid
features.description: Feature of the CSS Grid Layout Module Level 2 that allows a grid-item with its own grid to align in one or both dimensions with its parent grid.

features.title: CSS.supports() API
features.description: The CSS.supports() static method returns a Boolean value indicating if the browser supports a given CSS feature, or not.

features.title: CSS Table display
features.description: Method of displaying elements as tables, rows, and cells. Includes support for all `display: table-*` properties as well as `display: inline-table`

features.title: CSS3 text-align-last
features.description: CSS property to describe how the last line of a block or a line right before a forced line break when `text-align` is `justify`.

features.title: CSS Text Box
features.description: CSS `text-box` (and its longhands `text-box-trim` & `text-box-edge`) provide the ability to trim extra space over/under text glyphs at the start/end of a block to match specific font-provided metrics. This allows for more precise alignment and positioning of text.

features.title: CSS text-indent
features.description: The `text-indent` property applies indentation to lines of inline content in a block.

features.title: CSS text-justify
features.description: CSS property to define how text should be justified when `text-align: justify` is set.

features.title: CSS text-orientation
features.description: The CSS `text-orientation` property specifies the orientation of text within a line. Current values only have an effect in vertical typographic modes (defined with the `writing-mode` property)

features.title: CSS text-wrap: balance
features.description: Allows multiple lines of text to have their lines broken in such a way that each line is roughly the same width, often used to make headlines more readable and visually appealing.

features.title: CSS3 Text-shadow
features.description: Method of applying one or more shadow or blur effects to text

features.title: CSS touch-action property
features.description: touch-action is a CSS property that controls filtering of gesture events, providing developers with a declarative mechanism to selectively disable touch scrolling (in one or both axes) or double-tap-zooming.

features.title: CSS3 Transitions
features.description: Simple method of animating certain properties of an element, with ability to define property, duration, delay and timing function.

features.title: CSS unset value
features.description: A CSS value that's the same as "inherit" if a property is inherited or "initial" if a property is not inherited.

features.title: CSS Variables (Custom Properties)
features.description: Permits the declaration and usage of cascading variables in stylesheets.

features.title: CSS @when / @else conditional rules
features.description: Syntax allowing CSS conditions (like media and support queries) to be written more simply, as well as making it possible to write mutually exclusive rules using `@else` statements.

features.title: CSS widows & orphans
features.description: CSS properties to control when lines break across pages or columns by defining the amount of lines that must be left before or after the break.

features.title: CSS writing-mode property
features.description: Property to define whether lines of text are laid out horizontally or vertically and the direction in which blocks progress.

features.title: CSS zoom
features.description: Method of scaling content while also affecting layout.

features.title: CSS3 attr() function for all properties
features.description: While `attr()` is supported for effectively all browsers for the `content` property, CSS Values and Units Level 5 adds the ability to use `attr()` on **any** CSS property, and to use it for non-string values (e.g. numbers, colors).

features.title: CSS3 Box-sizing
features.description: Method of specifying whether or not an element's borders and padding should be included in size units

features.title: CSS3 Colors
features.description: Method of describing colors using Hue, Saturation and Lightness (hsl()) rather than just RGB, as well as allowing alpha-transparency with rgba() and hsla().

features.title: CSS3 Cursors (original values)
features.description: CSS3 cursor values added in the 2004 spec, including none, context-menu, cell, vertical-text, alias, copy, no-drop, not-allowed, nesw-resize, nwse-resize, col-resize, row-resize and all-scroll.

features.title: CSS grab & grabbing cursors
features.description: Support for the `grab` & `grabbing` values for the `cursor` property. Used to indicate that something can be grabbed (dragged to be moved).

features.title: CSS3 Cursors: zoom-in & zoom-out
features.description: Support for `zoom-in`, `zoom-out` values for the CSS3 `cursor` property.

features.title: CSS3 tab-size
features.description: Method of customizing the width of the tab character. Only effective using 'white-space: pre', 'white-space: pre-wrap', and 'white-space: break-spaces'.

features.title: CSS currentColor value
features.description: A CSS value that will apply the existing `color` value to other properties like `background-color`, etc.

features.title: CustomEvent
features.description: A DOM event interface that can carry custom application-defined data.

features.title: Date.prototype.toLocaleDateString
features.description: Date method to generate a language sensitive representation of a given date, formatted based on a specified locale and options.

features.title: Decorators
features.description: ECMAScript Decorators are an in-progress proposal for extending JavaScript classes. Decorators use a special syntax, prefixed with an `@` symbol and placed immediately before the code being extended.

features.title: DeviceOrientation & DeviceMotion events
features.description: API for detecting orientation and motion events from the device running the browser.

features.title: Window.devicePixelRatio
features.description: Read-only property that returns the ratio of the (vertical) size of one physical pixel on the current display device to the size of one CSS pixel.

features.title: Do Not Track API
features.description: API to allow the browser's Do Not Track setting to be queried via `navigator.doNotTrack`. Due to lack of adoption the Do Not Track specification was deprecated in 2018.

features.title: document.currentScript
features.description: `document.currentScript` returns the `<script>` element whose script is currently being processed.

features.title: document.evaluate & XPath
features.description: Allow nodes in an XML/HTML document to be traversed using XPath expressions.

features.title: Document.execCommand()
features.description: Allows running commands to manipulate the contents of an editable region in a document switched to designMode

features.title: Document Object Model Range
features.description: A contiguous range of content in a Document, DocumentFragment or Attr

features.title: Scroll methods on elements (scroll, scrollTo, scrollBy)
features.description: Methods to change the scroll position of an element. Similar to setting `scrollTop` & `scrollLeft` properties, but also allows options to be passed to define the scroll behavior.

features.title: Encrypted Media Extensions
features.description: The EncryptedMediaExtenstions API provides interfaces for controlling the playback of content which is subject to a DRM scheme.

features.title: ECMAScript 5
features.description: Full support for the ECMAScript 5 specification. Features include `Function.prototype.bind`, Array methods like `indexOf`, `forEach`, `map` & `filter`, Object methods like `defineProperty`, `create` & `keys`, the `trim` method on Strings and many more.

features.title: ECMAScript 2015 (ES6)
features.description: Support for the ECMAScript 2015 specification. Features include Promises, Modules, Classes, Template Literals, Arrow Functions, Let and Const, Default Parameters, Generators, Destructuring Assignment, Rest & Spread, Map/Set & WeakMap/WeakSet and many more.

features.title: ES6 classes
features.description: ES6 classes are syntactical sugar to provide a much simpler and clearer syntax to create objects and deal with inheritance.

features.title: ES6 Generators
features.description: ES6 Generators are special functions that can be used to control the iteration behavior of a loop. Generators are defined using a `function*` declaration.

features.title: JavaScript modules via script tag
features.description: Loading JavaScript module scripts (aka ES6 modules) using `<script type="module">` Includes support for the `nomodule` attribute.

features.title: JavaScript modules: dynamic import()
features.description: Loading JavaScript modules dynamically using the import() syntax

features.title: ES6 Number
features.description: Extensions to the `Number` built-in object in ES6, including constant properties `EPSILON`, `MIN_SAFE_INTEGER`, and `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`, and methods ` isFinite`, `isInteger`, `isSafeInteger`, and `isNaN`.

features.title: String.prototype.includes
features.description: The includes() method determines whether one string may be found within another string, returning true or false as appropriate.

features.title: Server-sent events
features.description: Method of continuously sending data from a server to the browser, rather than repeatedly requesting it (EventSource interface, used to fall under HTML5)

features.title: ui-serif, ui-sans-serif, ui-monospace and ui-rounded values for font-family
features.description: Allows more control when choosing system interface fonts

features.title: Feature Policy
features.description: This specification defines a mechanism that allows developers to selectively enable and disable use of various browser features and APIs. Feature Policy is deprecated and has been replaced with [Permissions Policy](/permissions-policy) and [Document Policy](/document-policy).

features.title: Fetch
features.description: A modern replacement for XMLHttpRequest.

features.title: File API
features.description: Method of manipulating file objects in web applications client-side, as well as programmatically selecting them and accessing their data.

features.title: FileReader API
features.description: Method of reading the contents of a File or Blob object into memory

features.title: FileReaderSync
features.description: Allows files to be read synchronously in Web Workers

features.title: Filesystem & FileWriter API
features.description: Method of reading and writing files to a sandboxed file system.

features.title: CSS Flexible Box Layout Module
features.description: Method of positioning elements in horizontal or vertical stacks. Support includes all properties prefixed with `flex`, as well as `display: flex`, `display: inline-flex`, `align-content`, `align-items`, `align-self`, `justify-content` and `order`.

features.title: gap property for Flexbox
features.description: `gap` for flexbox containers to create gaps/gutters between flex items

features.title: display: flow-root
features.description: The element generates a block container box, and lays out its contents using flow layout. It always establishes a new block formatting context for its contents. It provides a better solution to the most use cases of the "clearfix" hack.

features.title: system-ui value for font-family
features.description: Value for `font-family` that represents the default user interface font.

features.title: CSS font-feature-settings
features.description: Method of applying advanced typographic and language-specific font features to supported OpenType fonts.

features.title: CSS3 font-kerning
features.description: Controls the usage of the kerning information (spacing between letters) stored in the font. Note that this only affects OpenType fonts with kerning information, it has no effect on other fonts.

features.title: CSS Font Loading
features.description: This CSS module defines a scripting interface to font faces in CSS, allowing font faces to be easily created and loaded from script. It also provides methods to track the loading status of an individual font, or of all the fonts on an entire page.

features.title: CSS font-size-adjust
features.description: Method of adjusting the font size in a matter that relates to the height of lowercase vs. uppercase letters. This makes it easier to set the size of fallback fonts.

features.title: CSS font-smooth
features.description: Controls the application of anti-aliasing when fonts are rendered.

features.title: Font unicode-range subsetting
features.description: This @font-face descriptor defines the set of Unicode codepoints that may be supported by the font face for which it is declared. The descriptor value is a comma-delimited list of Unicode range (<urange>) values. The union of these ranges defines the set of codepoints that serves as a hint for user agents when deciding whether or not to download a font resource for a given text run.

features.title: CSS font-variant-alternates
features.description: Controls the usage of alternate glyphs associated to alternative names defined in @font-feature-values for certain types of OpenType fonts.

features.title: CSS font-variant-numeric
features.description: CSS property that provides different ways of displaying numbers, fractions, and ordinal markers.

features.title: @font-face Web fonts
features.description: Method of displaying fonts downloaded from websites

features.title: Fullscreen API
features.description: API for allowing content (like a video or canvas element) to take up the entire screen.

features.title: Gamepad API
features.description: API to support input from USB gamepad controllers through JavaScript.

features.title: Geolocation
features.description: Method of informing a website of the user's geographical location

features.title: Element.getBoundingClientRect()
features.description: Method to get the size and position of an element's bounding box, relative to the viewport.

features.title: getComputedStyle
features.description: API to get the current computed CSS styles applied to an element. This may be the current value applied by an animation or as set by a stylesheet.

features.title: crypto.getRandomValues()
features.description: Method of generating cryptographically random values.

features.title: Gyroscope
features.description: Defines a concrete sensor interface to monitor the rate of rotation around the device’s local three primary axes.

features.title: navigator.hardwareConcurrency
features.description: Returns the number of logical cores of the user's CPU. The value may be reduced to prevent device fingerprinting or because it exceeds the allowed number of simultaneous web workers.

features.title: Hashchange event
features.description: Event triggered in JavaScript when the URL's hash has changed (for example: page.html#foo to page.html#bar)

features.title: High Resolution Time API
features.description: Method to provide the current time in sub-millisecond resolution and such that it is not subject to system clock skew or adjustments. Called using `performance.now()`

features.title: ImageCapture API
features.description: The Image Capture API provides access to the Video Camera for taking photos while configuring picture-specific settings such as e.g. zoom or auto focus metering area.

features.title: Input Method Editor API
features.description: Provides scripted access to the Input Method Editor (IME). An IME is often used to input characters from East Asian languages by typing roman characters and selecting from the resulting suggestions.

features.title: Import maps
features.description: Import maps allow control over what URLs get fetched by JavaScript `import` statements and `import()` expressions.

features.title: IndexedDB
features.description: Method of storing data client-side, allows indexed database queries.

features.title: IndexedDB 2.0
features.description: Improvements to Indexed DB, including getAll(), renaming stores and indexes, and binary keys.

features.title: CSS inline-block
features.description: Method of displaying an element as a block while flowing it with text.

features.title: Directory selection from file input
features.description: The `webkitdirectory` attribute on the `<input type="file">` element allows entire directory with file contents (and any subdirectories) to be selected.

features.title: Selection controls for input & textarea
features.description: Controls for setting and getting text selection via `setSelectionRange()` and the `selectionStart` & `selectionEnd` properties.

features.title: Element.insertAdjacentHTML()
features.description: Inserts a string of HTML into a specified position in the DOM relative to the given element.

features.title: Internationalization API
features.description: Locale-sensitive collation (string comparison), number formatting, and date and time formatting.

features.title: IntersectionObserver
features.description: API that can be used to understand the visibility and position of DOM elements relative to a containing element or to the top-level viewport. The position is delivered asynchronously and is useful for understanding the visibility of elements and implementing pre-loading and deferred loading of DOM content.

features.title: IntersectionObserver V2
features.description: Iteration on the original API that also reports if the element is covered by another element or has filters applied to it. Useful for blocking clickjacking attempts or tracking ad exposure.

features.title: Intl.PluralRules API
features.description: API for plural sensitive formatting and plural language rules.

features.title: Intrinsic & Extrinsic Sizing
features.description: Allows for the heights and widths to be specified in intrinsic values using the `max-content`, `min-content`, `fit-content` and `stretch` (formerly `fill`) properties.

features.title: Lookbehind in JS regular expressions
features.description: The positive lookbehind (`(?<= )`) and negative lookbehind (`(?<! )`) zero-width assertions in JavaScript regular expressions can be used to ensure a pattern is preceded by another pattern.

features.title: JSON parsing
features.description: Method of converting JavaScript objects to JSON strings and JSON back to objects using JSON.stringify() and JSON.parse()

features.title: CSS justify-content: space-evenly
features.description: The "space-evenly" value for the `justify-content` property distributes the space between items evenly. It is similar to space-around but provides equal instead of half-sized space on the edges. Can be used in both CSS flexbox & grid.

features.title: High-quality kerning pairs & ligatures
features.description: When used in HTML, the unofficial `text-rendering: optimizeLegibility` CSS property enables high-quality kerning and ligatures in certain browsers. Newer browsers have this behavior enabled by default.

features.title: let
features.description: Declares a variable with block level scope

features.title: SVG favicons
features.description: Icon used by browsers to identify a webpage or site. While all browsers support the `.ico` format, the SVG format can be preferable to more easily support higher resolutions or larger icons.

features.title: localeCompare()
features.description: The `localeCompare()` method returns a number indicating whether a reference string comes before or after or is the same as the given string in sort order.

features.title: Magnetometer
features.description: Defines a concrete sensor interface to measure magnetic field in the X, Y and Z axis.

features.title: matches() DOM method
features.description: Method of testing whether or not a DOM element matches a given selector. Formerly known (and largely supported with prefix) as matchesSelector.

features.title: matchMedia
features.description: API for finding out whether or not a media query applies to the document.

features.title: maxlength attribute for input and textarea elements
features.description: Declares an upper bound on the number of characters the user can input. Normally the UI ignores attempts by the user to type in additional characters beyond this limit.

features.title: Media Capture from DOM Elements API
features.description: API to capture Real-Time video and audio from a DOM element, such as a `<video>`, `<audio>`, or `<canvas>` element via the `captureStream` method, in the form of a `MediaStream`

features.title: MediaRecorder API
features.description: The MediaRecorder API (MediaStream Recording) aims to provide a really simple mechanism by which developers can record media streams from the user's input devices and instantly use them in web apps, rather than having to perform manual encoding operations on raw PCM data, etc.

features.title: Media Source Extensions
features.description: API allowing media data to be accessed from HTML `video` and `audio` elements.

features.title: Web MIDI API
features.description: The Web MIDI API specification defines a means for web developers to enumerate, manipulate and access MIDI devices

features.title: CSS min/max-width/height
features.description: Method of setting a minimum or maximum width or height to an element.

features.title: CSS3 Multiple backgrounds
features.description: Method of using multiple images as a background

features.title: CSS3 Multiple column layout
features.description: Method of flowing information in multiple columns

features.title: Mutation Observer
features.description: Method for observing and reacting to changes to the DOM. Replaces MutationEvents, which is deprecated.

features.title: Web Storage - name/value pairs
features.description: Method of storing data locally like cookies, but for larger amounts of data (sessionStorage and localStorage, used to fall under HTML5).

features.title: File System Access API
features.description: API for manipulating files in the device's local file system (not in a sandbox).

features.title: Navigation Timing API
features.description: API for accessing timing information related to navigation and elements.

features.title: Network Information API
features.description: The Network Information API enables web applications to access information about the network connection in use by the device. Accessed via `navigator.connection`

features.title: Web Notifications
features.description: Method of alerting the user outside of a web page by displaying notifications (that do not require interaction by the user).

features.title: Object.entries
features.description: The `Object.entries()` method creates a multi-dimensional array of key value pairs from the given object.

features.title: CSS3 object-fit/object-position
features.description: Method of specifying how an object (image or video) should fit inside its box. object-fit options include "contain" (fit according to aspect ratio), "fill" (stretches object to fill) and "cover" (overflows box but maintains ratio), where object-position allows the object to be repositioned like background-image does.

features.title: Object.observe data binding
features.description: Method for data binding, a now-withdrawn ECMAScript 7 proposal

features.title: Object.values method
features.description: The `Object.values()` method returns an array of a given object's own enumerable property values.

features.title: Object RTC (ORTC) API for WebRTC
features.description: Enables mobile endpoints to talk to servers and web browsers with Real-Time Communications (RTC) capabilities via native and simple JavaScript APIs

features.title: Online/offline status
features.description: Events to indicate when the user's connected (`online` and `offline` events) and the `navigator.onLine` property to see current status.

features.title: Orientation Sensor
features.description: Defines a base orientation sensor interface and concrete sensor subclasses to monitor the device’s physical orientation in relation to a stationary three dimensional Cartesian coordinate system.

features.title: CSS outline properties
features.description: The CSS outline properties draw a border around an element that does not affect layout, making it ideal for highlighting. This covers the `outline` shorthand, as well as `outline-width`, `outline-style`, `outline-color` and `outline-offset`.

features.title: String.prototype.padStart(), String.prototype.padEnd()
features.description: The `padStart()` and `padEnd()` methods pad the current string with a given string (eventually repeated) so that the resulting string reaches a given length. The pad is applied from the start (left) of the current string for `padStart()`, and applied from the end (right) of the current string for `padEnd()`.

features.title: PageTransitionEvent
features.description: Fired at the Window when the page's entry in the session history stops being the current entry. Includes the `pageshow` and `pagehide` events.

features.title: Page Visibility
features.description: JavaScript API for determining whether a document is visible on the display

features.title: Passkeys
features.description: Passkeys, also known as Multi-device FIDO Credentials, provide users with an alternative to passwords that is much easier to use and far more secure.

features.title: Payment Request API
features.description: Payment Request is a new API for the open web that makes checkout flows easier, faster and consistent on shopping sites.

features.title: Permissions API
features.description: High-level JavaScript API for checking and requesting permissions

features.title: Permissions Policy
features.description: A security mechanism that allows developers to explicitly enable or disable various powerful browser features for a given site. Similar to [Document Policy](/document-policy).

features.title: Picture-in-Picture
features.description: Allows websites to create a floating video window that is always on top of other windows so that users may continue consuming media while they interact with other sites or applications on their device.

features.title: Pointer events
features.description: This specification integrates various inputs from mice, touchscreens, and pens, making separate implementations no longer necessary and authoring for cross-device pointers easier. Not to be mistaken with the unrelated "pointer-events" CSS property.

features.title: CSS pointer-events (for HTML)
features.description: This CSS property, when set to "none" allows elements to not receive hover/click events, instead the event will occur on anything behind it.

features.title: Pointer Lock API
features.description: API that provides access to raw mouse movement data. This is done by ignoring boundaries resulting from screen edges where the cursor can't go beyond, providing proper control for first person or real time strategy games.

features.title: Portals
features.description: Portals enable seamless navigation between sites or pages. A new page can be loaded as an inset using the `<portal>` element (similar to an iframe) which can then seamlessly transition to the new navigated state when "activated".

features.title: prefers-color-scheme media query
features.description: Media query to detect if the user has set their system to use a light or dark color theme.

features.title: prefers-reduced-motion media query
features.description: CSS media query based on a user preference for preferring reduced motion (animation, etc).

features.title: Promise.prototype.finally
features.description: When the promise is settled, whether fulfilled or rejected, the specified callback function is executed.

features.title: Promises
features.description: A promise represents the eventual result of an asynchronous operation.

features.title: Proximity API
features.description: Defines events that provide information about the distance between a device and an object, as measured by a proximity sensor.

features.title: Proxy object
features.description: The Proxy object allows custom behavior to be defined for fundamental operations. Useful for logging, profiling, object visualization, etc.

features.title: Push API
features.description: API to allow messages to be pushed from a server to a browser, even when the site isn't focused or even open in the browser.

features.title: rem (root em) units
features.description: Type of unit similar to `em`, but relative only to the root element, not any parent element. Thus compounding does not occur as it does with `em` units.

features.title: requestAnimationFrame
features.description: API allowing a more efficient way of running script-based animation, compared to traditional methods using timeouts. Also covers support for `cancelAnimationFrame`

features.title: requestIdleCallback
features.description: API allowing the execution of JavaScript to be queued to run in idle browser time, either at the end of a frame or when the user is inactive. Also covers support for `cancelIdleCallback`. The API has similarities with `requestAnimationFrame`.

features.title: Resize Observer
features.description: Method for observing and reacting to changes to sizes of DOM elements.

features.title: Resource Timing (basic support)
features.description: Method to help web developers to collect complete timing information related to resources on a document.

features.title: Rest parameters
features.description: Allows representation of an indefinite number of arguments as an array.

features.title: WebRTC Peer-to-peer connections
features.description: Method of allowing two users to communicate directly, browser to browser using the RTCPeerConnection API.

features.title: display: run-in
features.description: If the run-in box contains a block box, same as block. If a block box follows the run-in box, the run-in box becomes the first inline box of the block box. If an inline box follows, the run-in box becomes a block box.

features.title: Screen Orientation
features.description: Provides the ability to read the screen orientation state, to be informed when this state changes, and to be able to lock the screen orientation to a specific state.

features.title: scrollIntoView
features.description: The `Element.scrollIntoView()` method scrolls the current element into the visible area of the browser window. Parameters can be provided to set the position inside the visible area as well as whether scrolling should be instant or smooth.

features.title: Element.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
features.description: If the element is fully within the visible area of the viewport, it does nothing. Otherwise, the element is scrolled into view. A proprietary variant of the standard `Element.scrollIntoView()` method.

features.title: Selection API
features.description: API for accessing selected content of a document, including the `window.getSelection()` method, as well as the `selectstart` & `selectionchange` events on `document`.

features.title: Server Timing
features.description: Mechanism for web developers to annotate network requests with server timing information.

features.title: Service Workers
features.description: Method that enables applications to take advantage of persistent background processing, including hooks to enable bootstrapping of web applications while offline.

features.title: Efficient Script Yielding: setImmediate()
features.description: Yields control flow without the minimum delays enforced by setTimeout

features.title: Shared Array Buffer
features.description: Type of ArrayBuffer that can be shared across Workers.

features.title: Shared Web Workers
features.description: Method of allowing multiple scripts to communicate with a single web worker.

features.title: Speech Recognition API
features.description: Method to provide speech input in a web browser.

features.title: Speech Synthesis API
features.description: A web API for controlling a text-to-speech output.

features.title: Web SQL Database
features.description: Method of storing data client-side, allows SQLite database queries for access and manipulation.

features.title: getUserMedia/Stream API
features.description: Method of accessing external device data (such as a webcam video stream). Formerly this was envisioned as the <device> element.

features.title: Streams
features.description: Method of creating, composing, and consuming streams of data, that map efficiently to low-level I/O primitives, and allow easy composition with built-in backpressure and queuing.

features.title: Scoped attribute
features.description: Deprecated method of allowing scoped CSS styles using a "scoped" attribute. Now [removed from the specification](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/552) and replaced by the [@scope CSS rule](/css-cascade-scope).

features.title: SVG (basic support)
features.description: Method of displaying basic Vector Graphics features using the embed or object elements. Refers to the SVG 1.1 spec.

features.title: SVG in CSS backgrounds
features.description: Method of using SVG images as CSS backgrounds

features.title: SVG filters
features.description: Method of using Photoshop-like effects on SVG objects including blurring and color manipulation.

features.title: SVG fonts
features.description: Method of using fonts defined as SVG shapes. Removed from [SVG 2.0](https://www.w3.org/TR/SVG2/changes.html#fonts) and considered as a deprecated feature with support being removed from browsers.

features.title: SVG fragment identifiers
features.description: Method of displaying only a part of an SVG image by defining a view ID or view box dimensions as the file's fragment identifier.

features.title: SVG effects for HTML
features.description: Method of using SVG transforms, filters, etc on HTML elements using either CSS or the foreignObject element

features.title: Inline SVG in HTML5
features.description: Method of using SVG tags directly in HTML documents. Requires HTML5 parser.

features.title: SVG in HTML img element
features.description: Method of displaying SVG images in HTML using .

features.title: SVG SMIL animation
features.description: Method of using animation elements to animate SVG images

features.title: ES6 Template Literals (Template Strings)
features.description: Template literals are string literals allowing embedded expressions using backtick characters (`). You can use multi-line strings and string interpolation features with them. Formerly known as template strings.

features.title: Temporal
features.description: A modern API for working with date and time, meant to supersede the original `Date` API.

features.title: text-decoration styling
features.description: Method of defining the type, style and color of lines in the text-decoration property. These can be defined as shorthand (e.g. `text-decoration: line-through dashed blue`) or as single properties (e.g. `text-decoration-color: blue`)

features.title: text-emphasis styling
features.description: Method of using small symbols next to each glyph to emphasize a run of text, commonly used in East Asian languages. The `text-emphasis` shorthand, and its `text-emphasis-style` and `text-emphasis-color` longhands, can be used to apply marks to the text. The `text-emphasis-position` property, which inherits separately, allows setting the emphasis marks' position with respect to the text.

features.title: CSS3 Text-overflow
features.description: Append ellipsis when text overflows its containing element

features.title: CSS text-size-adjust
features.description: On mobile devices, the text-size-adjust CSS property allows Web authors to control if and how the text-inflating algorithm is applied to the textual content of the element it is applied to.

features.title: CSS text-stroke and text-fill
features.description: Method of declaring the outline (stroke) width and color for text.

features.title: TextEncoder & TextDecoder
features.description: `TextEncoder` encodes a JavaScript string into bytes using the UTF-8 encoding and returns the resulting `Uint8Array` of those bytes. `TextDecoder` does the reverse.

features.title: Touch events
features.description: Method of registering when, where and how the interface is touched, for devices with a touch screen. These DOM events are similar to mousedown, mousemove, etc.

features.title: CSS3 2D Transforms
features.description: Method of transforming an element including rotating, scaling, etc. Includes support for `transform` as well as `transform-origin` properties.

features.title: CSS3 3D Transforms
features.description: Method of transforming an element in the third dimension using the `transform` property. Includes support for the `perspective` property to set the perspective in z-space and the `backface-visibility` property to toggle display of the reverse side of a 3D-transformed element.

features.title: Trusted Types for DOM manipulation
features.description: An API that forces developers to be very explicit about their use of powerful DOM-injection APIs. Can greatly improve security against XSS attacks.

features.title: TTF/OTF - TrueType and OpenType font support
features.description: Support for the TrueType (.ttf) and OpenType (.otf) outline font formats in @font-face.

features.title: Typed Arrays
features.description: JavaScript typed arrays provide a mechanism for accessing raw binary data much more efficiently. Includes: `Int8Array`, `Uint8Array`, `Uint8ClampedArray`, `Int16Array`, `Uint16Array`, `Int32Array`, `Uint32Array`, `Float32Array` & `Float64Array`

features.title: FIDO U2F API
features.description: JavaScript API to interact with Universal Second Factor (U2F) devices. This allows users to log into sites more securely using two-factor authentication with a USB dongle.

features.title: unhandledrejection/rejectionhandled events
features.description: The `unhandledrejection` event is fired when a Promise is rejected but there is no rejection handler to deal with the rejection. The `rejectionhandled` event is fired when a Promise is rejected, and after the rejection is handled by the promise's rejection handling code.

features.title: URL API
features.description: API to retrieve the various parts that make up a given URL from a given URL string.

features.title: URLSearchParams
features.description: The URLSearchParams interface defines utility methods to work with the query string of a URL.

features.title: ECMAScript 5 Strict Mode
features.description: Method of placing code in a "strict" operating context.

features.title: CSS user-select: none
features.description: Method of preventing text/element selection using CSS.

features.title: User Timing API
features.description: Method to help web developers measure the performance of their applications by giving them access to high precision timestamps.

features.title: Variable fonts
features.description: OpenType font settings that allows a single font file to behave like multiple fonts: it can contain all the allowed variations in width, weight, slant, optical size, or any other exposed axes of variation as defined by the font designer. Variations can be applied via the `font-variation-settings` property.

features.title: SVG vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke
features.description: The `non-scaling-stroke` value for the `vector-effect` SVG attribute/CSS property makes strokes appear as the same width regardless of any transformations applied.

features.title: Vibration API
features.description: Method to access the vibration mechanism of the hosting device.

features.title: View Transitions API (single-document)
features.description: Provides a mechanism for easily creating animated transitions between different DOM states, while also updating the DOM contents in a single step. This API is specific to single-document transitions.

features.title: Small, Large, and Dynamic viewport units
features.description: Viewport units similar to `vw` and `vh` that are based on shown or hidden browser UI states to address shortcomings of the original units. Currently defined as the `sv*` units (`svb`, `svh`, `svi`, `svmax`, `svmin`, `svw`), `lv*` units (`lvb`, `lvh`, `lvi`, `lvmax`, `lvmin`, `lvw`), `dv*` units (`dvb`, `dvh`, `dvi`, `dvmax`, `dvmin`, `dvw`) and the logical `vi`/`vb` units.

features.title: Viewport units: vw, vh, vmin, vmax
features.description: Length units representing a percentage of the current viewport dimensions: width (vw), height (vh), the smaller of the two (vmin), or the larger of the two (vmax).

features.title: Screen Wake Lock API
features.description: API to prevent devices from dimming, locking or turning off the screen when the application needs to keep running.

features.title: Web Animations API
features.description: Lets you create animations that are run in the browser, as well as inspect and manipulate animations created through declarative means like CSS.

features.title: Web Bluetooth
features.description: Allows web sites to communicate over GATT with nearby user-selected Bluetooth devices in a secure and privacy-preserving way.

features.title: Web Serial API
features.description: Allows communication with devices via a serial interface.

features.title: Web Share API
features.description: A way to allow websites to invoke the native sharing capabilities of the host platform

features.title: WebCodecs API
features.description: API to provide more control over the encoding and decoding of audio, video, and images.

features.title: WebGPU
features.description: An API for complex rendering and compute, using hardware acceleration. Use cases include demanding 3D games and acceleration of scientific calculations. Meant to supersede WebGL.

features.title: WebHID API
features.description: Enables raw access to HID (Human Interface Device) commands for all connected HIDs. Previously, an HID could only be accessed if the browser had implemented a custom API for the specific device.

features.title: CSS -webkit-user-drag property
features.description: The non-standard `-webkit-user-drag` CSS property can be used to either make an element draggable or explicitly non-draggable (like links and images). See the standardized [draggable attribute/property](/mdn-api_htmlelement_draggable) for the recommended alternative method of accomplishing the same functionality.

features.title: Web NFC
features.description: This API allows a website to communicate with NFC tags through a device's NFC reader.

features.title: Web Sockets
features.description: Bidirectional communication technology for web apps

features.title: WebTransport
features.description: Protocol framework to send and receive data from servers using [HTTP3](/http3). Similar to [WebSockets](/websockets) but with support for multiple streams, unidirectional streams, out-of-order delivery, and reliable as well as unreliable transport.

features.title: WebUSB
features.description: Allows communication with devices via USB (Universal Serial Bus).

features.title: WebVR API
features.description: API for accessing virtual reality (VR) devices, including sensors and head-mounted displays. Replaced by the [WebXR Device API](/webxr).

features.title: Web Workers
features.description: Method of running scripts in the background, isolated from the web page

features.title: WebXR Device API
features.description: API for accessing virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) devices, including sensors and head-mounted displays.

features.title: CSS will-change property
features.description: Method of optimizing animations by informing the browser which elements will change and what properties will change.

features.title: CSS3 word-break
features.description: Property to prevent or allow words to be broken over multiple lines between letters.

features.title: CSS3 Overflow-wrap
features.description: Allows lines to be broken within words if an otherwise unbreakable string is too long to fit. Currently mostly supported using the `word-wrap` property.

features.title: Cross-document messaging
features.description: Method of sending information from a page on one domain to a page on a different one (using postMessage)

features.title: XMLHttpRequest advanced features
features.description: Updated functionality to the original XHR specification including things like file uploads, transfer progress information and the ability to send FormData. Previously known as [XMLHttpRequest Level 2](https://www.w3.org/TR/2012/WD-XMLHttpRequest-20120117/), these features now appear simply in the XMLHttpRequest spec.

features.title: DOM Parsing and Serialization
features.description: Various DOM parsing and serializing functions, specifically `DOMParser`, `XMLSerializer`, `innerHTML`, `outerHTML` and `insertAdjacentHTML`.
